questions.q: What did Hogan's interviews reveal about most millionaires?
a: They earned their wealth rather than inheriting it
Most inherited their money from family
Most gained it purely through investments
Most came from high-paying finance jobs
questions.why: Lesson 1 says most were self-made and did not inherit wealth.

questions.q: What does being wealthy really mean, according to the summary?
a: How much money you keep, not how much you make
How much you earn in a single year
How many expensive assets you display
How early you manage to retire
questions.why: Lesson 2 defines wealth by what you keep rather than earn.

questions.q: Which habit do millionaires share, per the summary?
a: Living below their means and saving consistently
Spending generously to signal their success
Relying on one steady salary
Borrowing heavily to buy property early
questions.why: Lesson 2 says they budget, invest, and live below their means.

questions.q: What does the summary say about the victim mentality?
a: It cannot coexist with a winning mentality
It helps people avoid risky decisions
It is common among the self-made
It fades automatically as income rises
questions.why: Lesson 3 says a winning and a victim mindset cannot coexist.

questions.q: What does intentionality mean in this summary?
a: Making things happen through deliberate decisions and plans
Waiting for luck to change your circumstances
Letting autopilot guide your spending habits
Copying what wealthy people buy and do
questions.why: Lesson 3 contrasts intentional action with sliding through life.
